title: Lanthanide complexes with oxygen bridges as models for potential upconversion materials

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations under vacuum using Schlenk techniques. First, [Cp2Er(THF)](μ-O)[Cp2Yb(THF)] was obtained from [Cp2Er(μ-OH)(THF)] (114 mg, 0.15 mmol) and Cp3Yb (108 mg, 0.29 mmol) in 20 ml THF at −50 °C; the yellow-green mixture was stirred for 3 days, concentrated to ca. 5 ml and kept two days at room temperature to give yellow-green crystals (170 mg, 76%). Then a THF (20 ml) solution of 2-(2-hydroxyphenyl)benzoxazole (132 mg, 0.62 mmol) was added to a THF (10 ml) solution of the oxo-bridged cyclopentadienyl precursor (141 mg, 0.16 mmol). The mixture was stirred 30 min at room temperature; solvent removal left a non-crystalline solid that was recrystallized from diethyl ether–hexane to a fine light yellow crystalline precipitate of 1, isolated by decantation and dried under reduced pressure (157 mg, 75%).
synthesis.temperature: first stage −50 °C then room temperature; ligand substitution at room temperature
synthesis.time: first stage stirred 3 days then 2 days crystallization; ligand substitution 30 min
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent evaporated; recrystallization from diethyl ether–hexane; decantation and drying under reduced pressure

properties.summary: Solid-state and THF-solution PL at 300 K under 405 nm laser excitation shows Yb3+ 2F5/2 → 2F7/2 emission at 980 nm with a Stark component at 1040 nm; no Er3+ emission in NIR or visible, indicating lack of Yb-to-Er energy transfer under the used conditions.

measurements.name: photoluminescence emission wavelength (Yb3+)
measurements.conditions: solid and THF solution, 300 K, λex 405 nm laser; 2F5/2 → 2F7/2

synthesis.procedure: A DME (5 ml) solution of Yb[N(SiMe3)2]3 (149 mg, 0.228 mmol) was added to a DME (10 ml) solution of 2-(2-hydroxyphenyl)benzothiazole (155 mg, 0.683 mmol) in the presence of trace H2O and O2. The mixture was stirred 1 h at 30 °C. Upon slow cooling to room temperature, light green crystals of 2 precipitated. The solution was decanted, crystals washed three times with cold DME and dried under vacuum (123 mg, 82%).
synthesis.temperature: 30 °C then slow cooling to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk / vacuum; crystallization from reaction mixture
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: light green crystals precipitated on cooling; washed 3× with cold DME; dried under vacuum

properties.summary: Solid-state NIR photoluminescence of 2 under 405 nm excitation is similar to complex 1 and related Yb OON complexes, with bands near 1027, 1050 and 1075 nm reflecting a comparable Yb coordination environment.

material_class.structural_family: oxo-bridged tetranuclear europium–lithium benzoxazolylphenolate ate cluster

synthesis.procedure: A DME (5 ml) solution of Eu[N(SiMe3)2]3 (142 mg, 0.22 mmol) and Li[N(SiMe3)2] (71 mg, 0.22 mmol) was added to a DME (10 ml) solution of 2-(2-hydroxyphenyl)benzoxazole (189 mg, 0.89 mmol) in the presence of trace O2. The mixture was stirred 1 h at 30 °C. Upon slow cooling to room temperature, light yellow crystals of 3 precipitated. The solution was decanted, crystals washed three times with cold DME and dried under vacuum (90 mg, 83%).
synthesis.temperature: 30 °C then slow cooling to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk / vacuum; crystallization from reaction mixture
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: light yellow crystals precipitated on cooling; washed 3× with cold DME; dried under vacuum

properties.summary: Europium cluster 3 showed neither ligand nor metal-centered luminescence, consistent with other Eu3+ complexes of OON-type ligands.
